title: Make the decision without pretending the map is complete
method: A conceptual sequence for the reflection exercise in this essay. The steps describe a possible practice, not a measured causal effect or a universal rule.
alt: Concept diagram: Separate the evidence — Distinguish observations, interpretations, and open questions.; Find the decisive assumption — Identify what could materially change the action.; Choose proportionate action — Match commitment and reversibility to the available evidence.; Set a review trigger — Name the information or event that will reopen the decision..
